name: launch
note: The music-led launch film: soft, short, mid-register effects mixed against the music bed instead of at a fixed level. Every role names its level over the bed (bed_db: the mix's loudest 50 ms at the effect over the music's median 50 ms level in the second before the cue), where it sits against the cut (offset_ms: taps, knocks and clicks lead, pop-in thumps and whoosh and swell peaks land after) and how close a run may go (min_gap_ms); ticks and bells are set wide. The numbers are medians measured on a private set of licensed reference clips; the members are the earshot 0.4 recipe sounds made for that style (ui_pop, knock, cut_hit, mallet, shutter, the thump-whoosh, the dark riser and swell, the mid ding). level_db is the same balance for a mixer without a bed (the loudest role at 0 dB). One gesture at a time: the music steps down before a hit, a drop, a big whoosh or a swell and comes back on it; nothing ducks under the effects. Every take passes the model-free audit (earshot kit check). Drum-free edition: kick, thump and sub-drop members replaced by clean equivalents (motion-graphics plugin 1.4).

stop_down.release: on the hit: the music comes back with it

tick.note: an airy 8.8 kHz tick (60 ms), set fully wide: ticks come in runs ~66 ms apart; felt in the run, as low over the bed as the light touches

tick.crisp.note: a bright designed tink for the crisper tick, a little wide

tock.note: a mid-band wooden knock (0.15 s, 400 Hz block): knocks lead the cut by ~40 ms

hit.note: (drum-free) a short dry marimba note (G4) for hero lands; was cut_hit/punch

pop.note: the soft rounded mid pop (0.14 s, 550 Hz, 22 ms onset, t20 75 ms): the most used effect, in runs ~114 ms apart

whoosh.short.note: a fast air whoosh (0.37 s, 570 Hz): its peak lands ~37 ms after the cut (swish/bright for a brighter 2.4 kHz flick)

swell.note: a darker near-mono reverse swell peaking ~42 ms after the cut; at most one a film (reverse_swell/cymbal for the bright wide cymbal)

key.note: realistic mid keys (1.3-4.4 kHz), a new take per keystroke, ~87 ms apart in a run

key.return.note: the run's own switch on its own seeds, a little louder

click.note: a small plastic click, a CC0 recording fitted as code: clicks lead the cut by ~11 ms

click.confirm.note: a rounded mid ding (690 Hz, 32 ms onset), the accent at the end of a run

snap.note: a camera shutter for snap zooms and whip-cuts (fit/snap/switch_flip for a toggle)

bell.note: a gated glockenspiel note doubled an octave under (0.35 s), C pentatonic G4-E6, set wide (L / R correlation 0.6): notes lead the cut by ~20 ms

text.note: one soft felt pluck per resolved fragment (C pentatonic C4-A4), low under the bed
